what: FYI: the v1 entry of blaze-engine dispatched `blaze-engine cache <verb>` to `blaze_cargo::remote::command`; since 05:57 the entry (crates/blaze-engine/src/program.rs) runs `blaze_cargo::cli::main` after the sandbox/stand-in/pin dispatch, and v2's cli has no `cache` command, so `blaze cache ...` no longer reaches remote. CI still runs `blaze-engine cache build` (.github/actions/blaze/action.yml:65, the store's key identity) and `cache push|pull` (actions/blaze-remote). If v2 keeps any store command, it belongs in v2's cli over blaze-cas (lane cargo); tell me if you want the entry to dispatch something before cli::main instead. Also still waiting on 00967 (versions.rs' HTTPS reader).
